description: V0.8 (unofficial, in progress): PHP payment-portal (paygate-php-portal) and Rust+TypeScript Tauri-style desktop (vaultdesk-tauri) tasks. 10 atomic hard tasks (5 paygate, 5 vaultdesk) spanning bugfix and contract categories. Hidden tests run via pytest wrappers that shell out to php / cargo / node and expose per-check partial credit. Not an official leaderboard suite until Opus-baselined.
